name: ViHero
summary: ViHero is a Xianyang robot manufacturer founded in 2017 and identified by Beijing Vizum as its wholly owned robotics subsidiary. It develops humanoid robots, dexterous hands and stereo-vision systems, with facilities for robot design, production and testing. Its product portfolio includes bipedal, wheeled and agricultural-picking humanoid platforms intended for service, research and industrial applications.
